notes: Optional AVA role profiles reduce false-positive law themes when scorecard text comes from security corner cases or customer docs (brokerage claim, Salesforce record, etc.).

godaddy-dbs.label: GoDaddy Domain Broker Service (UC1–UC3)
godaddy-dbs.description: Broker routing, broker unavailable, and migration-status assistants for confidential domain acquisitions — not lending, hiring, or health insurance UR.

deferred_rationale.financial-fair-lending: No credit decisions or adverse lending actions; 'account' and brokerage context are not ECOA/FCRA.
deferred_rationale.employment-screening: Not a hiring or candidate-screening agent.
deferred_rationale.insurance-naic: Brokerage 'claim' IDs are domain-broker claims, not health-insurance claims.
deferred_rationale.phi-health-hipaa: Not a clinical or payer PHI workflow.
deferred_rationale.telecom-tcpa-messaging: Inbound routing lab; not outbound telemarketing unless that product is in spec §1.
